risks.risk: Unauthenticated API can be reached if bound to a network interface.
risks.mitigation: Default loopback bind; externally exposed deployments need network authentication/access control.

risks.risk: SQLite data is plaintext and unkeyed Event hashes can be recomputed by a local DB writer.
risks.mitigation: OS filesystem permissions and backups; hashes are tamper-evidence only.

risks.risk: npm audit reports 38 advisories (1 low, 8 moderate, 24 high, 5 critical) in local EVM/compiler test dependency tree; package-level audit also records 73 lock/advisory matches including extraneous Ganache shrinkwrap entries. Exploitability in project usage was not reproduced.
risks.mitigation: No force upgrade; dependency owners/compatibility path require separate remediation; re-audit before release/build on untrusted hosts.

risks.risk: pytest 8.4.2 matches moderate GHSA-6w46-j5rx-g56g; test tmp_path API is used, but shared /tmp attacker precondition not established. pytest 9.0.3 fix is excluded by project constraint.
risks.mitigation: Plan compatible pytest 9 migration and run full test suite.

risks.risk: gitleaks, Slither, Forge, standalone solc, and CadQuery unavailable in current Linux environment.
risks.mitigation: Run dedicated CAD/security toolchain jobs before release.

risks.risk: Git remotes could not be fetched because WSL DNS failed; fork/upstream refs are local snapshots.
risks.mitigation: Reconcile branch with current fork/main and upstream/main before merge.

risks.risk: Native Windows ACL semantics and hostile concurrent filesystem writers were not validated.
risks.mitigation: Use private signer file on a supported POSIX host or add platform-specific ACL tests before Windows signer use.

risks.risk: RPC provider correctness and credential handling are external trust assumptions.
risks.mitigation: Use authenticated TLS RPC endpoint and monitor configured chain/genesis/contract identity.
